//: Firebase's auth handler, served from our own origin.
Sign-in runs through https://<authDomain>/__/auth/handler, and by
default that authDomain is khoj-cd80b.firebaseapp.com — a different
site from this one. Firebase then has to keep the in-flight sign-in in
storage belonging to firebaseapp.com, which is third-party storage from
this page's point of view, and Chrome and Safari block it. The redirect
goes to Google, comes back, and getRedirectResult finds nothing: the
person is returned to the app still signed out, with no error anywhere.
Proxying the handler makes the auth domain this domain. The storage
stops being third-party, the redirect completes, and a popup would also
end same-origin — which is what made window.closed unreadable and
MUST come before the SPA catch-all below, which would otherwise answer
these paths with index.html. Vercel matches rewrites in order.
